# SNCC Digital Gateway

> > Digital archive documenting the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee (SNCC) and its pivotal role in the 1960s Civil Rights Movement through biographies, events, and primary sources.

The SNCC Digital Gateway preserves the history of grassroots organizing for voting rights, student activism, and community empowerment across the American South. Featured content includes profiles of SNCC field secretaries, Mississippi Freedom Summer campaigns, MFDP organizing, and the movement's evolution from nonviolent direct action to Black Power politics.

## Key Topics

- Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee (SNCC)
- Mississippi Freedom Democratic Party (MFDP)
- Council of Federated Organizations (COFO)
- Voter registration campaigns
- Freedom Summer 1964
- McComb Movement
- Albany Movement
- SNCC field secretaries
- Bob Moses
- Stokely Carmichael
- Fannie Lou Hamer
- Student activism and organizing
- Nonviolent direct action
- Black Power movement
- Civil rights photography and documentation

## SNCC Organizers and Field Secretaries

- [Aaron Henry](https://snccdigital.org/people/aaron-henry): Aaron Henry, NAACP Mississippi president and SNCC mentor in COFO
- [Amelia Boynton](https://snccdigital.org/people/amelia-boynton): Amelia Boynton's voting rights work with SNCC in Selma, Alabama
- [Cleveland Sellers](https://snccdigital.org/people/cleveland-sellers): Cleveland Sellers organizing Black political power through SNCC
- [Bayard Rustin](https://snccdigital.org/people/bayard-rustin): Bayard Rustin's nonviolent activism and influence on SNCC debates
- [Annie Devine](https://snccdigital.org/people/annie-devine): Annie Devine's rural organizing and MFDP leadership in Mississippi
- [Frank Smith](https://snccdigital.org/people/frank-smith): Frank Smith's work as SNCC field secretary in Mississippi voter drives
- [Bob Mants](https://snccdigital.org/people/bob-mants): Bob Mants organizing voter registration in Lowndes County, Alabama
- [John O'Neal](https://snccdigital.org/people/john-oneal): John O'Neal, Free Southern Theater founder and SNCC field secretary

## Mississippi Movement Activists

- [Dorie Ladner](https://snccdigital.org/people/dorie-ladner): Dorie Ladner's activism in Hattiesburg Mississippi voting rights movement
- [Brenda Travis](https://snccdigital.org/people/brenda-travis): Biography of Brenda Travis, student activist in McComb Movement sit-ins
- [Aylene Quin](https://snccdigital.org/people/aylene-quin): Aylene 'Mama' Quin, local supporter of SNCC in McComb, Mississippi

## SNCC Policy and Organizing Strategy

- [Vietnam War Statement](https://snccdigital.org/inside-sncc/policy-statements/vietnam): SNCC's 1966 official anti-war policy statement on Vietnam War
- [Campus Travelers Program](https://snccdigital.org/inside-sncc/sncc-national-office/campus-travelers): SNCC campus travelers organizing student conferences and HBCU activism
- [Northern Student Movement Alliance](https://snccdigital.org/inside-sncc/alliances-relationships/northern-student-movement): Northern Student Movement alliance with SNCC for civil rights solidarity

## Movement Events and Programs

- [Child Development Group of Mississippi Head Start](https://snccdigital.org/events/child-development-group-mississippi-runs-head-start-programs): CDGM's Head Start programs linked to Mississippi Civil Rights Movement
- [SNCC Delegation to USSR](https://snccdigital.org/events/fay-bellamy-muriel-tillinghast-go-ussr): 1966 SNCC delegation visit to Soviet Union via Komsomol invitation
- [Bertrand Russell War Crimes Tribunal](https://snccdigital.org/events/courtland-cox-attends-bertrand-russell-international-war-crime-tribunal-in-stockholm): Courtland Cox represents SNCC at 1967 Stockholm War Crimes Tribunal

## Culture and Documentation

- [Art & Culture in the Movement](https://snccdigital.org/resources/sncc-discussions/art-culture): Freedom songs and cultural activism in SNCC organizing with oral history
- [Tamio Wakayama](https://snccdigital.org/people/tamio-wakayama): Tamio Wakayama, Canadian photographer documenting SNCC Freedom Summer
- [Martha Prescod (Norman)](https://snccdigital.org/people/martha-prescod-norman): Martha Prescod's organizing with Friends of SNCC and Freedom Singers
